criteria_keep_clean_base: one of apple, banana or orange is the dominant subject
whole fruit, not a cut section, a dish, a juice or a package
a photograph, not an illustration, painting, render, print or model
in focus and legibly exposed, so presuming it acceptable is defensible
criteria_keep_natural_scene: the target fruit is present and identifiable
a real scene: basket, bowl, table, stall, shop or market
non-plain background, ambient or artificial lighting
criteria_reject: fruit on the tree, blossom, orchard or plantation
a different species (pumpkin, physalis, cherry, peach, lime, mandarin)
illustration, painting, 3D render, postcard, diagram or product packaging
monochrome, which colour-based foreground isolation cannot be judged on
people or objects dominant with the fruit incidental
surplus to the per-bucket target once diversity caps were met

method: Every one of the 401 licence-cleared candidates was rendered as a numbered thumbnail on 12 contact sheets and reviewed by eye. Category membership on Commons tracks subject matter, not photographic composition, so both the fruit and the track recorded here are the reviewed judgement and override the category's proposal.
why_clean_base_is_presumed_acceptable: The undegraded Track A images carry a scored ACCEPTABLE label, so this pass deliberately rejected visibly soft or badly exposed photographs from that track. Track B was curated for subject identifiability only and carries no scored label, which is why deliberately hard images were kept there.
